description: Golden planning prompts for single vs multi-agent comparison. Run against a seeded profile so memory/saved-places personalization is exercisable.

cases.prompt: Plan my 7 days in Japan in November, split between Tokyo and Kyoto.
Plan a 3 day trip to Lisbon focused on food and viewpoints.
Plan a weekend in New York City, I've been before so skip the big tourist stuff.
Build an itinerary for 10 days in Bali balancing beaches, temples, and hiking.
Plan a 4 day Paris trip on a tight budget, street food over restaurants.
Plan 5 days in Rome. Keep days relaxed, we won't want more than two big activities a day.
Plan my 5 days in Seoul with a focus on markets, cafes, and one day trip outside the city.
Build an itinerary for 4 days in Mexico City centred on food — use any restaurants I've saved.
Plan a 6 day Iceland trip in summer with a rental car, starting and ending in Reykjavik.
Plan a 3 day Istanbul itinerary, group things by neighbourhood so I'm not zigzagging across the city.
Plan 4 days in Bangkok in September — account for the rainy season with indoor backups.
Plan a solo week in Amsterdam mixing museums, cycling, and quiet evenings — match my usual travel style.
Plan the itinerary for 8 days split between Lima and Cusco, with altitude acclimatisation built in.
Plan 3 days in Barcelona, then find cheaper restaurants for the whole trip.
Plan a week somewhere in Europe in spring — pick the destination based on what you know about me.
